title: W-CC-114
summary: Warning code W-CC-114 keeps purchase orders in Draft status when saved against a closed or dormant cost centre.
body:
Warning code W-CC-114 indicates that a purchase order contains an order line or header assigned to a closed or dormant cost centre [^r1][^r2][^r9]. The document saves with an order number in status DR (Draft) with editable lines instead of being rejected outright, displaying '<number> SAVED' on the status bar [^r6][^r9]. Because the order remains in Draft, it sits unapproved without reaching the supplier, and downstream steps such as printing, electronic transmission, receipting, and general ledger commitment posting are locked until resolved [^r10][^r11].

## Meaning
W-CC-114 is a non-fatal warning code returned in field `warn_cd` and displayed in the header's Warning field as well as the order list [^r1][^r7]. It signifies that the cost centre assigned to the document or order line is marked as CLOSED by Finance [^r2][^r6]. The document successfully saves with a generated document number, but it is held in status DR [^r2][^r6].

## Cause
The warning is triggered when an unapproved Draft purchase order or order line is raised or saved against a department cost centre that has been closed or rendered dormant in Finance, such as [[cc-prd-05|PRD-05]] [^r2][^r4][^r9][^r11].

## How to fix
To resolve W-CC-114, check [[screen-fin-cc-01|FIN-CC-01]] to identify an active departmental cost centre [^r3]. Update the cost centre on the line details via [[screen-pur-po-01|PUR-PO-01]] or amend the unapproved Draft order on [[screen-pur-pom-06|PUR-POM-06]] to an open account and re-save [^r3][^r5][^r7]. Re-saving the order against an active cost centre clears the warning and advances the document to status AP or PA according to standard rules, unlocking printing, electronic transmission, receipting, and GL commitment posting [^r5][^r10].

## Raised by
The warning is raised by the [[services-pur-po|PUR po services]] `po_save` and `po_amend` [^r8].

## Versions and conflicts
* **Superseded procedure wording (2025-02-01 vs 2023-05-01):** Under current [[sop-pur-002|SOP-PUR-002]] v1.4, warning W-CC-114 accompanies an order held in status DR when a cost centre assigned to an order line has been closed by Finance, retaining editable lines [^r2][^r9]. In superseded [[sop-pur-002|SOP-PUR-002]] v1.3 (2023-05-01), the warning was described specifically as appearing on the order header when the cost centre assigned on the original request was closed [^r12].

r1.quote: warn_cd (Warning): for example W-CC-114 when the order was saved as Draft against a closed cost centre.

r2.quote: DR means the order is stuck (usually a closed cost centre, warning W-CC-114); PA means it waits for approval; AP means it can be released.

r3.section: What to do when something does not look right
r3.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r3.quote: When an order remains in DR status with warning W-CC-114, the cost centre assigned to the line has been closed by Finance. You must check FIN-CC-01 to identify an active cost centre for the department, update the line details on the order screen, and re-save.

r4.loc_text: p. 4, §5. Procedure: notes and common mistakes
r4.quote: If you are resolving an issue with an unapproved draft that failed validation due to a closed department account, examine the warning panel for W-CC-114.

r5.quote: To rescue a Draft order stuck on a closed cost centre (warning W-CC-114), amend the cost centre to an open one. The order then becomes AP or PA by the normal rules.

r6.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r6.quote: Cause: the cost centre on the document is CLOSED. This is a warning, not an error: the document is saved with a number, in status DR

r7.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
r7.quote: The warning code is visible on the header's Warning field and in the order list. Remedy: amend the order to an open cost centre (§14.4).

r8.file: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf

r9.section: Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r9.loc_text: p. 3, Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r9.quote: the application accepts the entry into the database but sets the document status to Draft, displaying warning message W-CC-114 on the purchase order entry screen.

r10.section: Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r10.loc_text: p. 3, Orders saved against a closed cost centre are kept as Draft with warning W-CC-114 instead of being refused.
r10.quote: Testing must also ensure that once the cost centre is amended to an active account, the warning clears, the order status progresses normally, and commitment entries register across the management accounts.

r11.quote: Anything saved against it from now on will sit in Draft with warning W-CC-114 and will not reach the supplier.

r12.section: What to do when something does not look right
r12.loc_text: p. 4, What to do when something does not look right
r12.quote: If an order remains in status DR after saving, inspect the header for warning W-CC-114. This indicates that the cost centre assigned on the original request is no longer open in Finance.

sources: 03_ledgerline_manuals/MAN-ERR-72 Message and Error Code Reference v7.2.3.pdf
